Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

keysReloaded.description: Keys whose live value was updated by the reload — the hot-reloadable keys whose stored value differed from what was running. A no-op reload returns an empty array. Restart-gated keys are never included; they need config/restart.
